$comment: The oldest native bundle allowed to run. RAISING THIS LOCKS RIDERS OUT: a bundle below it cannot be used at all until its owner installs an update, and there is no way back for them from inside the app. Raise it only for a build that is known broken, because that cannot be fixed by a deploy — typically the wrong Supabase project baked in (PD-188 §1). NOTE the one break this CANNOT stop: a bundle built against the wrong ORIGIN (PD-188 §2) asks that wrong host for this file, gets an SSO page or nothing, and fails open for ever. scripts/native/assert-release-bundle.mjs is what catches that, before submission, which is the only place it can be caught. The web is never gated; only the native shell reads this. It is read from the DEPLOYED copy at https://app.letsride.social/app-version.json, so a change reaches devices when it reaches main, with no store review. src/lib/native/version-gate.ts is the reader and src/lib/version.ts holds the version each bundle reports.
